request.initial_prompt: _Evans._ It is qui, quæ, quod: if you forget your 70 'quies,' your 'quæs,' and your 'quods,' you must be preeches. Go your ways, and play; go.

raw_segments.text: Evans, it is qui, quæ, quod. If you forget your 70 quiz, your quies, and your quads, you must be preaches. Go your ways, and play. Go.
Evans, it is quee-quee-quod. If you forget your 70 quiz, your quees and your quads, you
must be preaches. Go your ways and play, go.
Evans, it is quee, quee, quad.
If you forget your 70 quiz, your quees, and your quads, you must be preachers.
Go your ways and play, go.
